policyFlip.from: dependency-free lane forbade a tracked package-lock.json (scripts/check-version-policy.js + .gitignore)
policyFlip.to: a tracked package-lock.json is REQUIRED as the reproducible-build authority; its ABSENCE or PR-deletion is the violation
policyFlip.rationale: a public, code-signed binary release must have reproducible dependency resolution and an auditable supply chain
policyFlip.verificationLanePreserved: the dependency-free trusted-verification-gate (ci.yml) still installs nothing; the install-free ban is now scoped to that ONE workflow so the separate supply-chain-build lane may run a clean install

pins.npmCi: reproduces 416 npm packages; verified locally + in supply-chain-build lane

checks.checkSupplyChain: scripts/check-supply-chain.js (--selftest + real): lockfile v3 + root match, exact devDep pins vs lockfile, engines, vendor hash drift, vendor coverage, npm+vendor license allowlist (permissive-only, no copyleft), SBOM freshness, notices coverage, arm64-only build env
checks.tests: tests/supply-chain.test.js 12/12 (8 fail-closed sandbox cases); version-bump-policy 16/16 (added H3 lockfile-required case)
checks.ci: ci.yml F2 step (dependency-free static supply-chain) + NEW .github/workflows/supply-chain-build.yml (npm ci reproducibility + post-install supply-chain governance)

licenseAudit.distribution: permissive-only (MIT/ISC/Apache-2.0/BSD/BlueOak/…); zero copyleft (no GPL/LGPL/AGPL/MPL/EPL/CDDL); fail-closed on any non-allowlisted license

vulnerabilityAuditProcedure: npm advisory DB lookup per vendored library on each version bump (recorded in vendor-manifest.json.vulnerabilityAudit); npm dependency tree audited via the permissive-license allowlist + pinned lockfile
note: H3 keeps the dependency-free verification lane intact and adds a reproducible-install + supply-chain-governance lane. No production runtime code changed. Vendored libraries retained (manifest route), not converted to npm imports.
